summary: I am a Full Stack Engineer and Mentor with experience in building real-world web, desktop, IoT, and system integration solutions. My expertise includes Python, Django, Django REST Framework, WebSockets, Redis, PostgreSQL, PySide6/PyQt, REST APIs, and modern frontend technologies. I have worked on real-time device management, payment and transaction systems, CRM platforms, vending machine ecosystems, analytics dashboards, Windows and Android applications, kiosk systems, and IoT integrations.

I focus on developing reliable, scalable, and user-centered software, from system architecture and backend APIs to desktop applications, deployment, and production maintenance. Alongside development, I mentor aspiring engineers, helping them move beyond theory through practical projects and real-world engineering challenges.
